facts.fact: Expansao reports the authority fined a company for failing to notify it and obtain its authorisation for an international transfer of personal data, so a rule requiring authorisation is in force.
facts.system: Authorisation for international transfer of personal data

facts.fact: Expansao reports the authority fined Crescer Tech the equivalent of USD 505,000 in June 2026 for sending personal data to a cloud outside Angola without notifying it or obtaining authorisation.
facts.system: Authorisation for international transfer of personal data

facts.fact: Expansao reports the authority fined Maxam the equivalent of USD 150,000 in April 2024 for illegally transferring a citizen's personal data to the United Kingdom.
facts.system: Authorisation for international transfer of personal data
